screen.title: Account

controls.label: Identity
controls.resetText: Puts the shown name back to your handle. The handle itself does not change.
controls.valueLabel: Identity, the name this account shows to you

controls.label: Password
controls.resetText: There is no reset. OSL cannot read the password you have, so it cannot put it back, and clearing it would leave this workspace open to whoever opens the lid.
controls.detail: Set, and last changed 12 January 2026. It is never shown, here or anywhere.
controls.valueLabel: Password is set and is not shown

controls.label: Recovery
controls.resetText: There is no reset. A new kit makes the words you already wrote down useless, and the old ones cannot be brought back.
controls.detail: 12 words, written down 4 March 2026. Shown only on the recovery screen, after your password.
controls.valueLabel: Recovery is set and is not shown

controls.label: Lock
controls.resetText: Puts the lock delay back to five minutes. Nothing else changes.
controls.detail: Locks this workspace when you step away from it.

controls.label: Stealth
controls.resetText: Clears the stealth password. The stealth workspace holds no messages, so nothing is lost.
controls.detail: Set. Entered at sign in, it opens an empty workspace.
controls.valueLabel: Stealth is set and is not shown

controls.label: Burn password
controls.resetText: Clears the burn password, so it can never be typed in by accident. It erases nothing.
controls.detail: Set. Entered at sign in, it permanently erases OSL data from this device. No recovery.
controls.valueLabel: Burn password is set and is not shown

controls.label: Pro code
controls.resetText: There is no reset. Removing the code puts this device back to free, and OSL cannot show you the code again to put it back.
controls.detail: Pro, this device, entered 18 February 2026. The code is never shown again.
controls.valueLabel: Pro code is set and is not shown

screen.html:
Account

7 controls. The five that stand for a secret show that it is set and nothing else, and Reset is offered only where putting the control back costs nothing.

  • IdentitySigned in as nora.vale.0324.Puts the shown name back to your handle. The handle itself does not change.
  • PasswordSet, and last changed 12 January 2026. It is never shown, here or anywhere.••••••••••••No resetThere is no reset. OSL cannot read the password you have, so it cannot put it back, and clearing it would leave this workspace open to whoever opens the lid.
  • Recovery12 words, written down 4 March 2026. Shown only on the recovery screen, after your password.••••••••••••No resetThere is no reset. A new kit makes the words you already wrote down useless, and the old ones cannot be brought back.
  • LockLocks this workspace when you step away from it.Puts the lock delay back to five minutes. Nothing else changes.
  • StealthSet. Entered at sign in, it opens an empty workspace.••••••••••••Clears the stealth password. The stealth workspace holds no messages, so nothing is lost.
  • Burn passwordSet. Entered at sign in, it permanently erases OSL data from this device. No recovery.••••••••••••Clears the burn password, so it can never be typed in by accident. It erases nothing.
  • Pro codePro, this device, entered 18 February 2026. The code is never shown again.••••••••••••No resetThere is no reset. Removing the code puts this device back to free, and OSL cannot show you the code again to put it back.

Keeps the identity and lock changes, and any control you reset.

Puts back only what can be put back: identity, lock, stealth, burn password.

All 7 account controls saved.
